desc: Re-derive exact operation semantics from statement + sample 1; confirm block-swap interpretation 0^X1^Y ↔ 1^Y0^X.
Formalize token model: operations preserve relative order of 1s and of 0s; k-th 1 in S maps to k-th 1 in T; counts of 1s must match.

Verify displacement invariant (1-tokens move by ±X, 0-tokens by ±Y); correct necessary conditions are per-rank mod X on 1-positions AND per-rank mod Y on 0-positions (gcd condition refuted; single mod-X condition refuted by `00011100`→`11100000`, X=3,Y=2).

Prove sufficiency of the joint invariant via constructive greedy (left pass/right pass) plus exhaustive mental BFS on small cases including X≠Y, m<Y, stuck configs — no counterexample found; X+Y>N subsumed by the uniform check.
Implement O(N) solution: extract 1-positions and 0-positions, check counts and per-index congruences (mod X for ones, mod Y for zeros), print Yes/No.
Final review: trace code on samples and adversarial edge cases (X+Y>N, m<Y, X=3,Y=2 case must be No), confirm zero-list length matches when #1s match, O(N) complexity, exact I/O format.
